findings.summary: ProcessPrReviewComments fails to integrate context selection and batching, continuing to process comments sequentially using taskRunner.execute() instead of executeBatch() or selectPrReviewContext().
findings.suggested_fix: Update ProcessPrReviewComments.execute to group unresolved comments, call selectPrReviewContext for each group, generate a V2 batch manifest, and process them using taskRunner.executeBatch().

findings.summary: The required batching dependencies (renderBatchTaskPrompt and extractBatchTaskResult) were added to ProcessPrReviewDeps but never wired in the composition root.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide renderBatchTaskPrompt and extractBatchTaskResult when instantiating ProcessPrReviewComments and PollTaskRunner in apps/api/src/compose.ts.

findings.summary: The test suite in process-pr-review-comments-batching.test.ts will fail because the tests mock and expect batching behaviors (like renderBatchTaskPrompt being called) that are completely absent in the implementation.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement the missing batching logic in process-pr-review-comments.ts so that the provided unit tests pass.
